body: Path: changing a running app without code | studio-authoring.custom-page-source-tiers | P1 ## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded) Triage: lands in `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/html-elements.tsx` (the html tier's `TAGS` passthroughs) and the `HTML_TIER_INTRINSICS` roster PR objectui#10753 added ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: on a `kind:'html'` page, `inline` resolves to the bare `code` key, which is the `field:code` widget's namespace fallback, and the authored text is dropped (measured by the objectui#10735 dev at `5ad3b888`). The `custom-page-source-tiers` item asserts that html source renders through the right path, but its steps never author a `code` tag. That is state ② ⇒ it inherits the item's **P2**. `reach:` is measured at the console's html-tier compile (a public UI door). Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T07:19Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), objectui#10735 and PR objectui#10753 (merged 2026-09-27T06:16Z), and objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112's ruling `5852014527`. **The serial constraint is gone.** PR objectui#10753 merged, and it owned `HTML_TIER_INTRINSICS`. Per the landing seat's note on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112 (`5853312677`), the published manifest now carries 47 html-tier tags; `div`, `code` and `kbd` are absent. **Direction.** It comes from ruling A on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112 ("a `kind:'html'` page may author the intrinsic tags its renderer registers; the published manifest declares that set"), so it is not a new ruling. 1. Register `code` as a sanitised passthrough in `TAGS`, the same shape as its siblings. ⛔ It must not shadow `field:code`'s namespaced key. 2. Add it to `HTML_TIER_INTRINSICS`, so the manifest declares it with `tier: 'html'`. 3. Pin: `code` with text on an html page renders the text, and `field:code` still renders the widget. 4. Record in `## Acceptance notes` whether `kbd` (also absent) has the same shape. ⛔ Do not widen to it on this card unless it is measured. 5. The objectstack side re-reads the manifest at its next `.objectui-sha` bump (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112's port list). No separate card is needed.
